info.name: WorkBoard External Public Activity (Action Items) Activity (Action Items) Workstream API
Get the details of Team Workstreams to which the authenticated user (token user) has access.

params.name: ws_id
params.description: The unique numerical id assigned to each Workstream in WorkBoard.

params.name: ws_owner
params.description: `Data-Admin` The numerical user id or email address of the user. The response will include all team Workstreams the user has access to.

items.docs:
Note:
The use of a `Data-Admin` token will not return all Workstreams for all users.
If no query string parameters are set, this will return Team Workstreams for Teams which the authenticated user (token user) is a member of. Personal Workstreams are not returned in the response.

info.name: Create a Workstream for a team.

items.docs: Create a new Workstream for a team, including a descriptive narrative and Workstream owner. You have to manage or co-manage this team, including Data-Admin token users.
